_comment: Regression tolerances for benchmark/bench_regression.py. A metric fails when
its increase (candidate - previous; |MBE| for bias) exceeds
max(floor, relative * previous). Only full-period statistics are gated;
seasonal and window breakdowns stay descriptive (bench_drift.py).
These are maintainer-reviewable defaults, not settled science. They were
calibrated so that the recorded release history under results/ passes:
energy-balance MAE moved by at most 0.03 W m^-2 between consecutive
releases; the RSL 6.5 m air-temperature MAE moved by +0.12 K at
2026.1.28 -> 2026.4.3, which exceeds the RSL tolerance and is listed under
'accepted' with its reason. The 0.05 floors match the display band used on
the benchmark page. Revise by PR; the CI sweep re-validates the history.

accepted.reason: RSL profile physics changed in this release cycle (c2m/c2h computed from HF08 RSL theory, PR #1116); the 6.5 m air-temperature MAE shift of +0.12 K shipped with 2026.4.3 and is recorded on the benchmark page.
